messages:
incident-bot: [AUTOMATED] Pager duty - Sev2: Model quality regression detected for tenant AcmeCorp (tenant-acme-42) on dedicated pool dp-us-east-3. Signal: normalized quality loss +18% vs baseline. Trigger: regression-detector job 2026-03-15T09:12Z.

alice (SRE): ack. I'm oncall. initiating triage. Is this tenant-only or pool-wide? @ben @carol please standby.

carol (SRE): here. grabbing relevant logs and routing rules. which model variant and quant profile?

alice (SRE): Model: acme-gpt-3.2 (v2026-03-10). Quant profile: q6_k_custom_v3 (tenant override) pushed yesterday to dp-us-east-3. Latency normal, automated evals show quality drop. Repro attached below.

ben (ML Eng): I saw the deploy. q6_k_custom_v3 tweaks per-channel scales for perf. Might underflow on long tails. Will triage. For mitigation we should fallback tenant to q6_k_stable_v2 (previous profile).

dina (Customer Success): Customer reported production chat returning incorrect numerics; they're concerned—this impacts billing displays. Notified account team.

alice (SRE): Plan: 1) Confirm isolation (tenant on dedicated dp-us-east-3). 2) Route new requests to stable profile. 3) Revert tenant override to previous quant profile. 4) Notify customer and execs. I'll execute rollback after ben confirms command.

ben (ML Eng): Confirm. Rollback command (will test in staging then prod):
```
# revert tenant quantization profile
redwood tenant update --id tenant-acme-42 --model acme-gpt-3.2 \
  --quant-profile q6_k_stable_v2 --pool dp-us-east-3
```
I can run now; expect 2-3m for workers and cache to stabilize. I'll run quick evals post-change.

carol (SRE): I'll patch runtime routing to prefer acme-gpt-3.2:q6_k_stable_v2 for tenant-acme-42 on dp-us-east-3. Applying now and will canary at 10%.

incident-bot: Deploy workflow started by carol at 2026-03-15T09:19Z. Job id: deploy-7782. Logs: https://deploys/redwood/job/deploy-7782

carol (SRE): Patch applied. Canary at 10% for tenant traffic. Monitoring quality probes.

alice (SRE): ben - anything in infra logs? saw token-confidence dips but no OOMs or infra errors.

ben (ML Eng): No infra errors. Minimal repro from our eval harness: 
```
prompt: "What is the total of 12, 15, and 30?"
q6_k_custom_v3 -> "26"
q6_k_stable_v2 -> "57"  # correct answer is 57
```
Custom_v3 returns wrong numeric output. Canary will show if rollback fixes.

dina (Customer Success): Notified AcmeCorp support channel: "We're rolling to a stable profile now, ETA ~10-20m for full mitigation. We'll follow up within 30m." Copying acct team.

applied-ml-bot: Quality eval summary: baseline pass rate 98.7% -> post q6_k_custom_v3 82.4% -> rollback canary initial sample 98.9% (100 samples). Recommendation: proceed with full rollback.

carol (SRE): Canary stable. Rolling to 100% for tenant-acme-42 now.

alice (SRE): Monitoring metrics for regressions and latency. Customer impact: high (incorrect monetary calculations). Dina keep CS/Legal looped.

ben (ML Eng): I opened PR with fixes and added unit tests to the quant profile repo: https://git/redwood/quant-profiles/pull/451. Will not reapply without extended evals and perf checks.

carol (SRE): Rollback to q6_k_stable_v2 completed. Traffic now fully served by stable profile. Observability: quality metrics back to baseline, no new errors.

alice (SRE): Handoff: I'm passing to night SRE eve for 3h watch. Summary: tenant-specific quant profile regression caused quality drop; isolated to dp-us-east-3 dedicated pool; rollback completed at 2026-03-15T09:37Z; customer notified; PR opened by ML. Postmortem owner: ben.

eve (SRE): taking over. Will monitor for 2 hours then close if stable.

dina (Customer Success): Customer acknowledges mitigation and requested postmortem ETA. Setting 48h.

carol (SRE): closing incident thread from infra side.

incident-bot: Incident 2026-03-15-T09:12Z resolved at 2026-03-15T09:40Z. Severity: Sev2. Postmortem required; owner ben. Tags: ["tenant-specific","quantization","rollback","dedicated-pool"]
